# nemau_health_monitor (Resource)

A health probe on a pool.

UDP pools accept only `UDP_CONNECT`. The engine detects failures on UDP passively, so the API refuses probe types it would not run.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_health_monitor" "web" {
  pool_id        = nemau_pool.web.id
  type           = "HTTP"
  delay          = 10
  timeout        = 5
  max_retries    = 3
  url_path       = "/health"
  expected_codes = "200-299"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `delay` (Number) Interval between two probes, in seconds, 1 to 3600. Changes in place.
- `max_retries` (Number) Consecutive failures before the backend is taken out, 1 to 10. Changes in place.
- `pool_id` (String) Id of the pool whose members are probed. A pool has one monitor.
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout for one probe, in seconds, shorter than `delay`. Changes in place.
- `type` (String) `HTTP`, `HTTPS`, `TCP` or `UDP_CONNECT`.

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) Administrative state, `true` by default; `false` takes the health monitor out of service. Changing it replaces the health monitor.
- `expected_codes` (String) HTTP codes that count as healthy: codes or ranges separated by commas, such as `200` or `200-299`. `200-399` when not set. Changes in place.
- `http_method` (String) `GET` (the default), `HEAD` or `OPTIONS`. Used by `HTTP` and `HTTPS` probes.
- `url_path` (String) Absolute path the probe requests, for example `/health`. Used by `HTTP` and `HTTPS` probes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Health monitor id.
